title: Restoring Scanning Privileges on a Granite Ridge Season Pass
content:
## When this facility applies

A Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass whose scanning privileges have been withdrawn is put back into the state in which it admits the holder at the lift, and the charge for that restoration is placed on the pass account. The charge for restoring scanning privileges is worked out only after the pass account carries a cleared payment entry dated later than every refusal standing against the pass. The figure charged is the one the collective's basis for a restoration charge produces; the agent works it out from the records and the published terms and passes it in.

## The business effect

The pass record moves to the scannable state, a restoration charge dated today is booked on the pass account, and the amount still to be collected rises by that charge, so the holder can scan again from that moment and sees the charge on their next statement.

## How it is invoked

The agent unlocks the hidden agent tool `restore_pass_scanning_08275b43` and then calls it. It is an agent-side tool and is not handed to the guest.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pass_id` | the reference number of the season pass record whose scanning privileges are being restored | an identifier, as returned by the season pass lookup |
| `restoration_charge_usd` | the charge placed on the pass account for this restoration | a fixed-format figure in USD to 2 decimal places, never negative and booked at exactly the figure given |

Neither parameter carries an enumerated set of values.

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence carrying the new pass account entry reference, a string beginning `prst_`, the pass record reference, the state the pass record now stands in, the charge booked in USD to 2 decimal places and the amount still to be collected on that pass account afterwards, also in USD to 2 decimal places. The presence of that entry reference is what indicates the restoration was recorded.

## Contract questions

*Is a pass account with an entry cleared later than every refusal standing against it what the charge waits on?* Yes. Until the pass account carries such an entry, the charge is not worked out.

*Does the tool decide the charge?* No. It books the figure passed to it and moves the record to the scannable state.
